<function name="Negate" parent="Vector" type="classfunc">
	<description>Negates this vector, i.e. sets every component to the negative value of itself. Same as `Vector( -vec.x, -vec.y, -vec.z )` but without creating new vector object</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<added>2021.12.15</added>
</function>
